prompt: What is prompt injection and how does Copilot cloud agent mitigate it?
explanation: Per GitHub Docs, prompt injection embeds hidden instructions in issues or PR comments. GitHub filters hidden characters before passing input to the agent.

options.text: A syntax error in a prompt; mitigated by spellchecking
Hidden malicious instructions in issues or comments; mitigated by filtering hidden characters (HTML comment content) before the input reaches the agent
A too-long system prompt; mitigated by truncation
A typo in the MCP server URL; mitigated by DNS validation
